card.line: Adria was the sea between Greece, Italy, and Sicily. Paul's ship was driven across it in a storm on the way to Rome.

moments.title: Driven across the sea
moments.text: On the fourteenth night the ship was still being driven across the Adriatic Sea. About midnight the sailors sensed they were near land, and they dropped four anchors and prayed for daybreak.

moments.title: Paul stops the sailors
moments.text: The sailors tried to escape in the lifeboat. Paul told the centurion and soldiers that the men must stay with the ship to be saved, so the soldiers cut the lifeboat loose.

moments.title: Paul urges them to eat
moments.text: Right up to daybreak, Paul kept urging everyone to eat. They had been in constant suspense for fourteen days without taking any food.
